pages.text: Pongi put on a little bag. Her pajamas were inside.
Today Pongi was sleeping at Grandpa Goose's house. "I'll sleep without crying."
Grandpa spread out the bedding for her. The pattern on the ceiling was unfamiliar.
Pongi pulled the blanket up to her nose. Her eyes were wide awake.
Knock, knock. Grandpa opened the door.
Dad was standing at the door. "I was just... passing by."
Dad sat on the sofa. "I'll just sit here a little while, then go."
Pongi opened her eyes. The window was bright. Dad was asleep on the sofa.
Grandpa put a blanket over Dad. Pongi giggled.
Pongi put on her bag and stood by the door. Dad was still snoring.
